reason: I have never heard of this company and no salon owner I know or my product distributor uses it. The money is not the problem; I will not put my billing and my staff's routine on an app nobody I trust has tried.
objection: My staff are busy with customers and will not type every walk-in's number and bill into a phone, so in two weeks it will be half-filled and I will be back to my register and counting the drawer myself anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running for a few months in a salon owned by someone I know, or my distributor recommending it, and hearing from that owner that the staff actually use it every day.
